issues.message: login(username, password) logs the raw password via console.log — credential exposure in logs (can end up in log aggregators, crash reports, terminals, etc.). Remove logging of the password entirely.
login() has no actual authentication logic — it only logs its arguments and returns nothing, so it's either a dead stub or missing the real credential-check implementation.
console.log("dividing", a, b) added to divide() looks like leftover debug output with no log level or structured format; remove or replace with a proper logger if logging is actually intended.
